achievements.name: Hitting the Mark
achievements.how: Chop 15 yellow sections in a row during the Choppin' Minigame

achievements.name: Minecart Maniac
achievements.how: Slam on a yellow ore vein in the Mining Minigame, which gives 3 points!
achievements.reward: +5% Mining EXP Bonus for all characters

achievements.name: Spike Minigame Master
achievements.how: Get a score of 13 in the spike minigame. Remember to say 'If u love me let me go'
achievements.notes: Score means winning at least 13 Gems, not getting to round 13.

achievements.name: Minecart Master
achievements.how: Get a score of 103-- in the Mining Minigame, beating the developers highscore!

achievements.name: Choppin' to the Beat
achievements.how: Get a score of 141-- in the Choppin' Minigame, beating the developer's highscore!

achievements.name: Decked Out in Gold
achievements.how: Equip Gold Helmet , Chestplate, Pants, Shoes, two Golden tools, and the Defenders Dignity ring.

achievements.name: Two-Time Savior
achievements.how: Equip the Blunder Hero Trophy, while also having another in your inventory.
achievements.reward: +5% Faster Respawn for all Blunder Hills mobs

achievements.name: What a View!
achievements.how: Climb the 2nd tallest tree in all of Blunder Hills, and say 'Great view, 1 star'
achievements.notes: Climb the rightmost tree in the Birch Enclave and type 'Great view, 1 star' into chat.

achievements.name: Seriousleaf-ast!
achievements.how: Score a point in the Choppin' Minigame while the leaf is zooming at hyperspeed
achievements.notes: Every time the leaf hits the side, it speeds up (you need to score points to see the speed increase). "Hyperspeed" is around 30 minutes of waiting.

achievements.name: Heyo!
achievements.how: Say 'Hi' to 250 different people without closing the game.
achievements.notes: World changing is allowed and is Case-Sensitive

achievements.name: Golden Fly
achievements.how: Pass through the small golden hoop in the Catching Minigame. It's worth 3 points!

achievements.name: Wassup Yo!
achievements.how: Say 'Hi' to 100 unique people without closing the game or changing Servers.

achievements.name: Fishing Finesse
achievements.how: Get a score of 67+ in the Fishing Minigame, beating the developers highscore!

achievements.name: Catching Coronation
achievements.how: Get a score of 128+ in the Catching Minigame, beating the developers highscore!

achievements.name: A Fish Too Far
achievements.how: Catch a total of 1000 fish across all Fishing Minigame plays.
achievements.notes: This means landing your bobber on 1000 total fish within the minigame, not collecting fish item drops.

achievements.name: Monocle No More
achievements.how: Defeat 160 Sand Giants within 10 minutes of entering the map. Auto must be off.
achievements.reward: ">30px|link= Twilight Desert BG for Title Screen

achievements.name: Threadin' the Needle
achievements.how: Pass through the teenie tiny Lava hoop in the Catching Minigame. It only appears if you go through 20 hoops in a row!

achievements.name: Two Desserts!
achievements.how: Have the YumYum Sheriff trophy equipped, while also having another in your inventory.
achievements.reward: +5% faster respawn for YumYum Desert Monsters

achievements.name: WAAAAAAAHH!
achievements.how: Complete all available Treasure Hunts! You can find them on Youtube, just search for it!

achievements.name: Fish Aint Biting
achievements.how: I'm tellin' ya, the fish ain't bitin' today gosh darn it!
achievements.notes: Miss 100 times in a row in the fishing minigame, then catch a fish.

achievements.name: Wazzzzam!
achievements.how: Wazam 125 rooms in Snakenhotep's Dungeon by performing exceptionally well in a room.

achievements.name: Just Passing By
achievements.how: Pass 30 rooms in Snakenhotep's Dungeon by doing the thingy the room says to do.

achievements.name: Good Times Roll
achievements.how: Beat wave 50 in Glublin Gorefest using ONLY Boulder Roller wizards. No freeze, no confetti, just boulder.

achievements.name: Giant Slayer
achievements.how: Defeat 5 Giant Mobs of each type; Bloque, Mamooth, Snowman, Penguin, and Thermister. Do it in order too, so 5 Bloques first, then 5 Mamooths, etc
achievements.reward: " >30px|link= Tundra Outback BG for Title Screen
achievements.notes: A message appears on screen for any five giants killed, not just the ones in the achievement. The message is just a visual bug, only the listed giant monsters c

achievements.name: There Can Be Only 1
achievements.how: Beat wave 50 of Wakawaka War without using more than 1 of any specific tower. Can't have 2 pulsers, or 2 frozones!

achievements.name: Knock on Wood
achievements.how: Beat wave 50 of Acorn Assault with just 4 towers active. Place down a 5th tower at any time, and it wont count!

achievements.name: Sepia Vision
achievements.how: Have a stack of exactly 500 Black Lense s in your Storage Chest. Better complete this before I make it 1,000!
achievements.reward: " >30px|link= Crystal Caverns BG for Title Screen
achievements.notes: You can manually drag a second stack into your storage chest. Use "split stack" to get the exact amount.

achievements.name: A Most Nice Sale
achievements.how: You SOLD gems to the World 3 town store...? All at once? How many...? Nice.
achievements.notes: Sell a stack of exactly 69 gems to the world 3 town store. You can manually drag a second stack into your inventory using the split stack feature.

achievements.name: Boss Defeated
achievements.how: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 1st difficulty
achievements.reward: +2% Total DMG for all characters outside of dungeons

achievements.name: Manager Defeated
achievements.how: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 2nd difficulty
achievements.reward: +3% Total DMG for all characters outside of dungeons

achievements.name: Kingpin Defeated
achievements.how: Defeat Glaciaxus on its 3rd difficulty
achievements.reward: +5% Total DMG for all characters outside of dungeons

achievements.name: Capitalist Win
achievements.how: Complete 1000 jobs within the Glacial Basement dungeon.
achievements.reward: +5% Class EXP bonus for all characters outside of dungeons

achievements.name: Matrix Wickermen
achievements.how: Accumulate 8760 hours, or an entire year, of Lab AFK time across all players.

achievements.name: Bland Dish
achievements.how: What exactly were you expecting to cook, an invisible meal?
achievements.notes: Attempt to discover a new recipe by cooking without any Spices

achievements.name: Lv. 5 Nothing
achievements.how: Ah, I see you enjoy reading upgrade flavor text as well!
achievements.notes: Level up the "No Upgrade Selected" upgrade to level 5 in the "Upgrade" tab of the Breeding menu

achievements.name: Chippin' Away
achievements.how: Claim 25 chips from the Chip Repository. I was gonna make this 250 chips, but people from the future told me not to.

achievements.name: Hunned Times a Day
achievements.how: Claim spices by any means 10,000 times. Like, individual claims.

achievements.name: Space Party!!!
achievements.how: Dance with at least 5 other people while you're all in World 4 town!
achievements.notes: Type '/dance' in chat to do a little jig.

achievements.name: Hibernating Gamer
achievements.how: Glaim 110,000 hours of AFK time. Jeez, thats like an entire year of all characters idling to the max.

achievements.name: Soda Poisoning
achievements.how: Beat wave 50 of Clash of Cans with 3 Poisonic Elders at Lv 5 or higher. Also, you can't sell towers.
achievements.reward: ">30px|link= Starfield Belt BG for Title Screen

achievements.name: The True Pirate
achievements.how: Reach a total of 1 million Plunderous Kills. This one is the true challenge of the three.

achievements.name: The True Emperor
achievements.how: Reach a total of 1 million Wormhole Kills.

achievements.name: Maple Logger
achievements.how: Have a stack of exactly 200,000 Maple Logs in your Storage Chest.

achievements.name: No Krakens? ):
achievements.how: Reach Wave 50 of Citric Conflict tower defence without placing a single Kraken Towers. Not even one.

achievements.name: Maroon Warship
achievements.how: Upgrade a boat to Lv 300 in Sailing. This is the pinnacle of naval prowess, it doesn't get fancier than this!
achievements.reward: +1 Lv to all Talents for all characters

achievements.name: POiNG Champion
achievements.how: Get a POiNG score of 25,000 or more! My personal highscore is 38,323 at the time of coding this!

achievements.name: Chemical Collector
achievements.how: Harvest a total of 1000 Chemical-type Plants in Gaming.

achievements.name: Perfect Trade Deal
achievements.how: Make a trade deal with Blobby G worth exactly 777K Gold Bars. You get a bit of wiggle room, like within 500 Gold Bars.
achievements.reward: +1 additional Treasure Per Chest for Sailing

achievements.name: Legendary Flag
achievements.how: On your Siege Breaker, get a Flag Score of 150 or more on Erruption River. This is the number above your Flag!

achievements.name: Legendary Wormhole
achievements.how: On your Elemental Sorcerer, get a Wormhole Score of 83 or more on Niagrilled Falls. This is the number above your Wormhole!

achievements.name: Sneaky Stealing
achievements.how: Walk to a uh... weird location? Well it's not that weird, but it's just like, what ya doin' back there?
achievements.reward: +25% Shop Capacity for all Town Shops
achievements.notes: Walk to the left of the W5 Shop mole.

achievements.name: Hug from Timmy
achievements.how: The lil' fella REALLY likes icecream!
achievements.notes: Complete Little Timmy's four Ice Cream Justice encounters.

achievements.name: That's MY Crown
achievements.how: Have a stack of exactly 100000000 Royal Headpiece in your Storage Chest.

achievements.name: Leet Lanterns
achievements.how: Oh yea that's a good number. Sure it's no 69420 but it's vintage!
achievements.notes: Have a stack of exactly 1337 Dark Lantern in your storage

achievements.name: Doctor Repellant
achievements.how: Have 10000 or more Apple crops in your Depot at once. You can lock the first crop before it grows to guarantee an apple!

achievements.name: Cob Enjoyer
achievements.how: Have 1000000 or more Corn crops in your Depot at once. Mmmm Corn!

achievements.name: Legumulucky
achievements.how: Make a crop trade with the Legumulyte worth exactly 777 magic beans.

achievements.name: Yellow Belt
achievements.how: Find a +50 Yellow Belt Sneaking Charm. Yes exactly +50.

achievements.name: Penta Defence
achievements.how: Reach Wave 50 in Breezy Battle without placing more than 5 Towers in total.

achievements.name: Beanstacker Prodigy
achievements.how: Add 14 different golden foods to The Beanstalk.
